sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of tizanidine during breastfeeding. If the mother requires tizanidine, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Monitor the infant for drowsiness, adequate weight gain, and developmental milestones, especially in younger, exclusively breastfed infants.
